_comment: Translations of the German table kampf_k24, written by tools/i18n/locales_kampf_k24.py. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns.

strings.+%d%% power for each Energy spent on art: 本场战斗中每在招式上花费1点能量，威力+%d%%，最多%d点。
strings.A Soaked Spirling loses 2 Energy at the: 湿透的Spirling在每回合结束时失去2点能量。
strings.A Spirling that fought and waits on the: 出战过并在替补席等待的Spirling每回合也获得1点能量。换人就是有不在场证明的休息。
strings.A Spirling that has fought gains %d Ener: 已经出战过的Spirling在替补席等待时，每回合获得%d点能量。
strings.It has paid too much to stop now. Every: 已经付出太多，停不下来了。本场战斗中每在招式上花费一点能量，命中就更重一分。
strings.Pick Rest: it skips its art but gains 2: 选择休息：它会跳过招式，但在回合的1点之外再得2点能量。对手可不会礼貌地等着。
strings.The water seeps into %s: it loses %d Ene: 水渗进了%s：它失去了%d点能量！
strings.Tip: Watch the pips fill back up. Restin: 提示：看着能量格重新填满。休息才能让能量回家。
strings.Tip: Your Spirling is running low on Ene: 提示：你的Spirling能量快不够了。付不起的招式放不出来。
